changes.reason: Firm-owned clients table linked through case_parties.client_id; the migration merges existing client parties per firm and normalized name, skips precedents, downgrades without loss, ends in one Alembic head after merging main and states in offline SQL that linking was skipped.

Firm-scoped /clients API: search, counts without precedents, validated create and partial update, stats and case ordering, rename propagation including archived cases, admin-only delete with the 409 rule, 404 across firms; router registered in main.

The cases API links client parties by client_id or find-or-create, refuses another firm's client with 422 and writes nothing, never keeps client_id on non-client parties, links the legacy client_name path and filters the case list by client.
Seed and import link client parties through find-or-create, keep user-edited demo contacts, never link precedents (a precedent re-import unlinks), and demo firm removal deletes its clients first.
